title: EX-04 — confined effect matrix, exhaustion and typed refusals
fixture_label: offline scripted-lane legs + the pinned actual-execution packet (hh-ops-live/1, R5.44); input-required is not approval; scratch is not sandbox; live legs owed to ADR-0363

prerequisites.companion: the actual §5 matrix evidence is the pinned R5.44 packet (allow/Kp4, deny, pause/respond/resume, exhaustion on podman); the card verifies it and drives the deterministic exhaustion/refusal legs

negative_controls: stale pin — a drifted card sha256 or edited packet refuses stale_pin before any execution
absent/fake event — a packet leg outside the closed set, an untyped verdict, a missing denominator or a mutated discharged predicate fails packet/matrix
unsupported command/recovery — env.suspend/env.resume/respond_permission/amend answer typed refusals verbatim; none becomes an approval
fixture promoted to task/study — the card's fixture_label and the packet's honest dispositions are retained verbatim; no live or study claim follows

costs.build: one cargo build/test of hharness + deps (minutes, existing toolchain); no added dependencies
costs.runtime: seconds; one scripted-lane run parked on the cap + four typed refusal calls; no network, no provider, $0

limitations: the packet leg verifies the retained hh-ops-live/1 record verbatim — the real pause/respond/resume and Kp4 cells ran on podman under R5.44's authorized scope; the card does not re-run them
the exhaustion leg drives the scripted lane's own model_calls cap — the same typed control.budget.exceeded/decision vocabulary, not the podman O6/O7 drive
scratch is not sandbox — no confinement claim follows from the scripted lane
fixture/scratch posture — never S1/S3, useful-task, live or study evidence
